### Rent T2

For a 2‑room flat (≈ 45–60 m²) in Villach, realistic low‑cost prices are:

€500–€650 → cheapest range, usually older buildings, unfurnished

€650–€800 → standard long‑term rentals, unfurnished or partly furnished

€900+ → furnished, modern, serviced apartments (the expensive ones you saw)

If you want economic, you should avoid serviced apartments and look at private landlords or standard long‑term leases.
